programmes.d: Marcia falls for a boy who is more interested in bugs than girls.
Greg works part-time at Mike’s architectural firm.
Bobby refuses to share with the girls when he finds $1100.
Peter gets a black eye when he tries to defend his little sister.
Jan feels insecure about her freckles when her crush falls for Marcia.
Ann's opportunity to perform in a Broadway play opposite Barry Sullivan is jeopardized by her inability to slap him.
While working as a flight attendant in order to land a job on an airline television commercial, Ann mistakes a private investigator for a hijacker.
Ann is selected for jury duty.
Ann flies to Los Angeles for a series of TV commercials along with Donald, who tags along to do a magazine story about violence in the entertainment industry.
Ann's commercial work proves to be more grueling than she could possibly have expected.

Felix turns psychic in the Psychic, Shymcic episode of The Odd Couple. Invoking his ESP Felix warns a skeptical Oscar not to attend a gala dinner at which he is to be named sportswriter of the year. But Oscar ignores the danger awaiting him.
Sportscaster Howard Cosell, in a neat bit of type-casting, plays Howard Cosell, a famous sportscaster who becomes involved in a feud with Oscar Madison.
In The Princess, Miss Simmons plays Lydia of Lichtenstein who visits Felix's studio for a portrait sitting and meets Oscar, who, unaware of her station, tries to date her.
Felix decides to become a writer and Oscar thinks he's wasting his time and money.
Oscar tries to cover up his divorce from his visiting mother by moving Felix out and ex-wife Blanche.

Cindy gets into trouble when she starts telling a string of lies.
Bobby suffers from a fear of heights after he falls off a ladder.
Mom said don't play ball in the house. The boys do anyway, and Peter's errant pass of basketball results in Carol's favorite vase getting broken.
Jan gets carried away with pulling pranks on her family.
Greg gets caught with cigarettes in his school jacket. He's been caught smoking once before (and quit immediately). Therefore, nobody believes him when he truthfully says they're not his.
Jan wears a brunette wig in hopes of being noticed.
Ann gets stuck in the shower and the new neighbor comes to her rescue.
Ann is mugged in Central Park and, though she survives without a scratch, she desperately tries to conceal the incident from her father.
Jerry and Ruth's marriage is on the rocks, and a remorseful Jerry is interrupting Ann and Donald's time with each other.
Donald interviews a wealthy heiress named Trixie Weatherby (Benay Venuta), a woman who has been married six times. Ann fears she might turn Donald into her seventh husband.
Donald hires a new secretary (Mary Frann), who she suspects is trying to make a move on him...and could actually succeed.
The Screen Actors Guild gives Ann a huge paycheck, and she struggles with what to do with it.
Felix is given an opportunity to direct a razor commercial on television, provided that he gets Deacon Jones to appear in it.
Oscar tells Myrna the story of why Felix has been banned from Midtown Memorial Hospital ever since his daughter's birth in The First Baby.
Felix plans a surprise birthday party for Oscar -who loathes birthday parties.
Allen invites Oscar to be a celebrity contestant on his ABC show, and eager Felix persuades him to accept the offer and to take him along as his partner.
Felix turns to Oscar for help after complaining he no longer can communicate with his daughter.
